validated_objective: Release QIF v0.7.1 with an executable Outcome Collection Ledger that preserves every outcome observation revision, correction, and custody transition while keeping the latest snapshot reproducible
scope: calibration-report collection policy, observation revision, source correction, custody event, and ledger assessment records
deterministic verifier checks, example-only collecting package, retained negative fixtures, docs, portable package, and release
constraints: do not overwrite prior revisions, mutate prospective enrollment, collect external data, claim source truth, or grant custody or operational authority
counts, corrections, evidence status, and ledger completeness remain evidence rather than quality
expected_outcomes: late-arriving outcomes and source corrections preserve what was known before and after each append
the current empirical outcome snapshot exactly matches the latest ledger revision or validation fails
